source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
**EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER** units in your army may ignore modifiers (some or all) to their Move, **Advance rolls** and **Charge rolls**.

Your **WARLORD**’s unit starts the battle as the Favoured Champions. Each turn, whichever player's it is, the first time an **EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER** unit of yours destroys an enemy unit, that **CHARACTER** unit takes over as Favoured Champions once all its attacks are resolved.

Models in your Favoured Champions unit may re-roll their **[Wound rolls](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls)**.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 8 of 296 combat readings of Detachment rules (every record of the class not withheld otherwise, each time) wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

favouredChampions.replaceAt: after all the triggering unit’s attacks resolve
favouredChampions.trigger: first enemy unit destroyed by a friendly Emperor’s Children Character unit in each player turn
